beats.say: Cymbal runs 40 pipelines from cron, on one small machine.
beats.sub: pipelines on cron, on one VM

beats.say: Turn them into DAGs that repeat, backfill, and shout when they break.
beats.label: Station 5.2 · Automation
beats.head: Repeat. Backfill. Shout when broken.

beats.say: A DAG is a recipe with steps in order.
In Cloud Composer, you write it in Python. Tasks, and arrows between them.
beats.label: In Composer
beats.head: Tasks, and arrows between them

beats.say: Composer only gives the orders. BigQuery and Dataflow do the cooking.
beats.label: Remember
beats.head: Composer orders. Others cook.

check.prompt: Which write is safe to retry?
options: Overwrite the partition of that day
Insert with a new random ID
check.why: An overwrite gives the same table after one run or after ten.

beats.say: The golden rule: a task must be safe to run twice.
Tasks get retried. If each retry appends rows, you get duplicates.
beats.label: Why
beats.head: Retry + append = duplicates

beats.say: So overwrite the partition for that day, or use MERGE. Run it ten times: same result.
beats.label: The fix
beats.head: Overwrite the day, or MERGE

beats.say: The word for this is idempotent.
beats.label: The word
beats.head: Idempotent
beats.text: Run it again, get the same answer

beats.say: Rule two: never ask the clock.
Use the run date that Airflow gives you, not now.
beats.label: Dates
beats.head: Use the run date, not "now"

beats.say: Then a backfill for last March really loads last March.
beats.label: Backfills
beats.head: A backfill loads the right day

beats.say: Finally, add retries with a delay, a timeout, and an alert on failure.
beats.label: Make it loud

beats.say: A good task is idempotent, uses the run date, retries, and is loud when it fails.
beats.label: Station 5.2
